title: Jump Game
statement: Start at index 0. From index i you can move forward by at most nums[i] positions without leaving the array. Decide whether some sequence of moves reaches the last index.

examples.explanation: Jump over the first zero, then advance one position.
The only first move lands on a zero.
The starting index is already the destination.

hints: Conceptual: A zero matters only if every route must stop there.
Directional: Track the rightmost reachable index as you scan.
Implementation: Process only indices at or before the frontier. Extend it with the current index plus its jump limit.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) time and O(1) extra space.
